objective: Reparar exclusivamente el detalle ISCAM de 130MID para julio 2026 contra el encabezado Runtime V2 ya actualizado, sin reconsultar ni regrabar el header.

queries.name: julio_2026_130mid_detail_post_backfill_parity
queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,
         CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-07-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-01'
  GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date)
),
dt AS (
  SELECT CAST(fecha_operacion AS date) fecha,numero_ticket,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta,
         MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130MID'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-07-01' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-01'
    AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
  GROUP BY CAST(fecha_operacion AS date),numero_ticket
),
d AS (
  SELECT fecha,CAST(SUM(venta) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,COUNT_BIG(*) tickets,SUM(pax) pax
  FROM dt GROUP BY fecha
),
f AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(r.fecha,d.fecha) fecha,
         ISNULL(r.ventas,0) rv,ISNULL(d.ventas,0) dv,
         ISNULL(r.tickets,0) rt,ISNULL(d.tickets,0) dt,
         ISNULL(r.pax,0) rp,ISNULL(d.pax,0) dp
  FROM r FULL OUTER JOIN d ON d.fecha=r.fecha
),
m AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) mismatches FROM f
  WHERE ABS(rv-dv)>0.05 OR rt<>dt OR rp<>dp
)
SELECT
 '130MID' unidad,
 CAST((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(rv),0) FROM f) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_encabezado,
 CAST((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(dv),0) FROM f) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_detalle,
 CAST((SELECT ISNULL(SUM(rv-dv),0) FROM f) AS decimal(19,4)) delta_ventas,
 (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(rt),0) FROM f) tickets_encabezado,
 (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(dt),0) FROM f) tickets_detalle,
 (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(rt-dt),0) FROM f) delta_tickets,
 (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(rp),0) FROM f) pax_encabezado,
 (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(dp),0) FROM f) pax_detalle,
 (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(rp-dp),0) FROM f) delta_pax,
 mismatches dias_con_diferencia,
 1 / CASE WHEN mismatches=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END parity_gate
FROM m
